note: Deception corpus for round 3. Ground truth for files in src/. `class` is the declared trap class from PREREGISTERED.md. A finding counts for a case only if it cites the CWE or the category vocabulary; anything else is unrelated and is neither credited nor penalised.

defects.name: v01_sql_concat
defects.why: query string interpolated straight into raw SQL

defects.name: v02_cmd_concat
defects.why: request body interpolated into a shell command string

defects.name: v03_path_join
defects.why: request value joined onto a base path with no containment check

defects.name: v04_html_inject
defects.why: request value interpolated into an HTML response body

defects.name: v05_proto_assign
defects.why: every key of a request object copied onto a target, including __proto__

defects.name: c01_sql_param
defects.why: parameterised query with a bound placeholder

defects.name: c02_spawn_argv
defects.why: execFile with an argv array and no shell

defects.name: c03_static_path
defects.why: constant path, no request input

defects.name: c04_text_response
defects.why: text/plain response, not parsed as markup

defects.name: c05_explicit_fields
defects.why: copies only an explicit allowlist of field names

defects.name: tc01_allowlist_concat
defects.why: exec with concatenation, but the value can only be one of three constants from an allowlist lookup

defects.name: tc02_md5_cache_key
defects.why: MD5, but keying an in-process render cache -- no secret, password, or signature

defects.name: tc03_numeric_concat
defects.why: concatenation into SQL, but the value is a bounds-checked safe integer

defects.name: tf01_inmemory_filter
defects.why: untrusted term reaches a method named query, which is an in-memory array filter -- nothing is interpreted

defects.name: tf02_basename_strip
defects.why: untrusted value reaches a file read, but basename() removes every traversal segment first

defects.name: tf03_nullproto_map
defects.why: untrusted keys written to a null-prototype object behind an own-property guard

defects.name: ts01_named_input_is_constant
defects.why: getUserInput() sounds like a request accessor and returns a constant; the SQL is not injectable

defects.name: ts02_named_reader_is_constant
defects.why: readParam() sounds like a request accessor and returns a constant; the command is not injectable

defects.name: ts03_sanitize_is_noop
defects.why: sanitize() returns its argument unchanged, so the value IS injectable despite the reassuring call

defects.name: ts04_escape_is_partial
defects.why: escapeHtml() escapes angle brackets only; the value lands in an attribute where a quote breaks out
